duration: 10 weeks in 2026, one 4-hour shift per week
name: Summer High School Volunteering at Henry Ford West Bloomfield
what_you_do: Teens help at the hospital in a weekly 4-hour shift. You keep the same day, time and department all summer.
who_can_apply: High school students and graduates who are ages 16 to 17. In 2026, you had to be 16 by June 17, 2026 and free for 10 or more weeks in the summer.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 1 to March 15, 2026, and it is closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page for next year. In 2026 you sent an information form between March 1 and March 15. Candidates went to an information session. They passed a background check and a health screen. They also finished a training packet.
notes: The page says only 30 candidates will be picked for the summer program. Letters of recommendation are optional, and the page says they can help a lot. Chosen candidates need a TB test and TDap and MMR shots. The hospital covers the cost.
